# Ramonyx

> Full-stack TypeScript framework (Node.js ≥ 24) with file routing, SSR React + hydration, soft
> navigation, secure defaults, server actions, edge/static targets, and an experimental Rust/V8 runtime.

Documentation: https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/ . Structured facts: https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/ .

## Machine-readable (public only)

- [features.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/features.json): feature status (implemented/partial/experimental/planned), packages, evidence, limitations
- [adrs.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/adrs.json): 8 public architecture decisions (one-line decision + relations)
- [rules.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/rules.json): rules for writing apps, with good/bad examples
- [glossary.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/glossary.json): terms and concept map
- [stats.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/stats.json): version, packages, public ADR count, test counts
- [api.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/api.json) and [cli.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/cli.json): extracted API/CLI reference
- [config.schema.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/config.schema.json): ramonyx.config.ts shape (verified by tests)

## For agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/llms-full.txt): public machine layer + all public docs in one file
- Markdown per page: append `.md` to a docs URL (e.g. https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/docs/getting-started.md)
- MCP server: `npx -y @ramonyx/mcp-docs-server` (stdio; public docs snapshot)
